summary.en: Australia and the Philippines have signed a new defence pact as tensions with China over the South China Sea intensify, including disputes over Ayungin Shoal. Philippine Coast Guard spokesperson RADM Jay Tarriela has publicly likened states that violate international law to the fictional villain Voldemort, and engaged in heated exchanges with Chinese and Chinese-affiliated scholars at the Manila Dialogue. ASEAN leaders gathered but a code of conduct for the South China Sea remains unlikely. The UCDP recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Australia og Filippinene har signert en ny forsvarspakt mens spenningene med Kina i Sør-Kina-havet øker, inkludert tvister om Ayungin-skjæren. Filippinernes kystvaktspersonell RADM Jay Tarriela har offentlig liknet stater som bryter internasjonal rett på den fiktive skurken Voldemort, og har hatt opphetede utvekslinger med kinesiske og kinesisk-tilknyttede forskere under Manila-dialogen. ASEAN-ledere samlet seg, men en atferdskodeks for Sør-Kina-havet virker usannsynlig. UCDP registrerte 176 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
